title: Dragon Over Magical Stairs
description: A black cartoon dragon with wide eyes and a blue scarf flies in the center of a surreal scene, carrying a small red-cloaked figure. Behind it is a glowing green moon, an ornate circular staircase adorned with flowers and bones, and a cracked yellow building covered in vines and flowers.
prompt: A black cartoon dragon with big white eyes and a blue scarf flying through the air carrying a small red hooded figure. Behind them is a giant glowing green moon, an ornate decorative spiral staircase with flowers and bones, and a cracked old yellow building with archways covered in flowering vines. The ground is broken cobblestone with scattered objects. Dramatic swirling sky with orange and blue clouds turning into black smoke, whimsical fantasy style, vibrant colors.
